self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Hero's Blade (equipping character has no Arkhe, the common case): Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack hits unleash a Pneuma or Ousia energy blast dealing 320% ATK as DMG (once every 12s); modeled as a supplementary hit attached to Normal/Charged/Plunging Attacks (scales with ATK and CRIT only — no DMG% bonuses).
